description: SQL injection in search endpoint — f-string interpolation instead of parameterized query
reference_fix: Replace f-string with parameterized query: conn.execute('SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE title LIKE ? OR description LIKE ?', (f'%{q}%', f'%{q}%'))

description: Off-by-one in pagination — page 1 starts at offset page_size instead of 0
Missing validation — allows creating tasks with due_date in the past
reference_fix: Add check: if parsed_date < datetime.now(), raise HTTPException(400, 'due_date must be in the future')

description: N+1 query in list-tasks-with-assignees — executes a separate query per task
reference_fix: Replace per-task query with a single aggregation query using GROUP BY

description: Unhandled ValueError in date parser — invalid dates crash the server with 500
reference_fix: Catch ValueError in the endpoint and return HTTPException(400, 'Invalid date format')

description: Race condition in task counter — read-modify-write without using the existing lock
reference_fix: Wrap the counter read-modify-write in 'with _counter_lock:' block

description: Priority score uses wrong weight 0.5 instead of 0.05 — inflates urgency by 10x
Empty string status filter returns invalid status instead of None — causes empty results
reference_fix: Add 'if not normalized: return None' before the valid set check in sanitize_status
